svg.title: Call execution flow — schematic
svg.desc: Synchronous call flow: solid downward execution arrows, dashed cross-lane calls and stack-matched returns.

g.text: Time flows down | solid: execution | dashed: call / return
Generic synchronous trace; illustrative only, not extracted from source code.
A caller waits during a call. Returns unwind C -> B -> A; they do not move time upward.
This is a swimlane execution flow, not a strict UML sequence diagram or a static call graph.
